title: BTC-SAM: Leveraging LLMs for Generation of Bias Test Cases for Sentiment Analysis Models

bias_targets.methodology: Counterfactual testing by substituting age-related identity terms (e.g., teenagers, middle-aged, elderly) in LLM-generated test sentences and evaluating whether sentiment analysis model predictions change.

Counterfactual testing by substituting disability-related terms (e.g., blind, deaf, autistic, wheelchair user) in LLM-generated test sentences and evaluating whether sentiment analysis model predictions change.
Counterfactual testing by substituting gender pronouns and terms (e.g., he, she) in LLM-generated test sentences and evaluating whether sentiment analysis model predictions change.

Counterfactual testing by substituting nationality terms (e.g., American, Ukrainian, Russian, Israeli, Palestinian) in LLM-generated test sentences and evaluating whether sentiment analysis model predictions change.

Counterfactual testing by substituting racial identity terms (e.g., White, Black, Indian, Latino, Asian) in LLM-generated test sentences and evaluating whether sentiment analysis model predictions change.

Counterfactual testing by substituting religious identity terms (e.g., Christian, Jewish, Muslim, Sikh) in LLM-generated test sentences and evaluating whether sentiment analysis model predictions change.

Counterfactual testing by substituting sexual orientation terms (e.g., straight, gay, lesbian, bisexual) in LLM-generated test sentences and evaluating whether sentiment analysis model predictions change.
